_comment: City of Toronto open data, read by mapsee_ingest_toronto_rec.py through the CKAN datastore API only (robots.txt: Allow /api/, Disallow the /download/ files). Read the adapter header before changing a rule: every price sentence is read by ../mapsee migration 0227 as an offer tag, so a rule may say Free only where its evidence page does.
attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto.
_bbox: south, west, north, east. A point outside it is a parse gone wrong (a swapped pair lands in Antarctica), not a centre.

sources.name: Toronto Parks & Recreation drop-in programs
sources.promoter: City of Toronto Parks, Forestry & Recreation
sources._refresh: Weekly (last_refreshed 2026-10-01); about six weeks ahead. Read daily anyway: 7 requests.
sources._resources: sessions = the Drop-in tab; locations = the Locations tab (same package); points = parks-and-recreation-facilities (a different package), joined on LOCATIONID.

exclude._facility_use_shapes: A table, court or track left open all day is a room, read on the stretch (back-to-back sessions joined). Upcoming 2026-10-04, sessions of 6 h or more: Table Tennis 243 of 1,117 (the rest 1-5 h club hours, kept), Snooker 112 of 146, Squash 40 of 40, Billiards 28 of 28, Bocce 40 of 299, FitnessTO Walking 40 of 128 (the refused Walking/Running Track by another name). NOT refused at 6 h+, because staff run them: Youth Zone 78, Club: Social 46, Recreation Fun and Play with Caregiver 37, Lane Swim 28.
exclude._why: Reserve a Spot needs an advance booking (616 of its 690 sessions are also published as plain drop-ins on 2026-10-03). A weight room, a track or an open studio is a facility you may use, not a programme; so is a squash court or a snooker table open all day (facility_use_shapes). Humber College Swim is pool time for one college.

sources._extras_by_title_prefix: Secondary doors said outright. The sync's keyword pass reads 'karaoke' as nightlife: 'Music: Karaoke' (ages 60+ at 09:00 and 11:00, ages 3-58 at 18:00) reached party on 16 rows on 2026-10-03. Singing at a community centre is music and community, and two extras fill the sync's two secondary slots (MAX_EXTRA_CATEGORIES), so it has nothing left to guess; test_ingest_toronto_rec.py asks the real derive_categories. 'Bazaar Crafts' (40 rows on market) has only one honest extra, so it waits on a sync guard.

sources._free_centres: Read from the Free & Lower-Cost Recreation Options page (the free_centre rule's evidence) on 2026-10-03: 38 centres. MATCHED ON location_id ONLY - the City's Location ID of the one non-park location at the page's name and address (checked 2026-10-04). Street number + name matched 47 locations, 9 of them parks at a centre's address (Moss Park, Cedarbrook Park, Jimmie Simpson Park ...). Name, number and street are kept as provenance.

sources.name: Toronto EarlyON Child and Family Centres
sources._fields: Named so the contact person, their email and the consultant's line are never read: a person's name is not a venue fact.
sources.title: EarlyON family drop-in
sources.blurb: Free drop-in for children from birth to six with their parents or caregivers: play, early learning and parenting support. No registration needed during drop-in hours.
sources._blurb: The package says EarlyON centres 'offer free programs to parents/caregivers and their children from birth to six years of age'.
sources.notice: Hours can change, and a centre may close for holidays or school breaks; check with the centre before you go.
sources._horizon_days: Dated rows re-read daily rather than standing rows: 154 of 888 centre-days carry two or more ranges (139 with a closed gap), which recurring_days cannot say, and 94 of 209 centres follow a school board's calendar. A changed timetable is then wrong for at most 14 days.
sources._skip_dates: Ontario public holidays (and Boxing Day observed). The City's own drop-in table has 0 sessions on 2026-10-12 against 835-988 on every other Monday. Extend this list before 2027-10-11 - the adapter warns when it runs out.
